arjun: Heads up — argocd app-of-apps sync/prune is hung for eu-west-1 GPU apps after yesterday's storageClass change. Several apps are OutOfSync because prune keeps failing on PVC updates. Anyone oncall?

marta: what error are we seeing? logs?

arjun: kubectl describe shows the kube API rejecting the update. snippet from application-controller logs:

```
E0305 14:21:02.123456 1 generic.go:123] apply failed for resource persistentvolumeclaim/gpu-cache-1: PersistentVolumeClaim "gpu-cache-1" is invalid: spec: Forbidden: updates to field(s) [spec.storageClassName] are not allowed
Reconciler: app-of-apps/eu-gpu-stack, sync failed, prune failed
```

deploy-bot: :alert: argocd: sync failed for apps: gpu-worker-eu-01, gpu-worker-eu-02, gpu-training-eu. Reason: prune failed (resource update rejected by API).

kevin: ok — this is the classic "storageClassName is immutable" case. Quick mitigation: stop ArgoCD from pruning so the rest of the tree can progress. We can toggle the parent App's sync-options to disable prune temporarily. e.g.

```
kubectl -n argocd patch application app-of-apps-eu --type=merge -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options":"Prune=false"}}}'
```

That will let new/updated apps apply without ArgoCD trying to delete/replace the PVCs. Not a fix for the PVCs, just unblocks rollouts.

sre-oncall: +1 to temporary Prune=false. If we leave prune disabled too long we accumulate drift. Plan to re-enable after migration.

marta: after we do that, what is the safe migration path for the PVCs? deleting them will lose data for some workloads.

hana: options: 1) create new PVCs with the new storageClass and update Deployments/StatefulSets to reference the new PVC names (requires app manifests update), 2) perform a storage-level migration (rsync between pods using a migration job + attach to new PVC), or 3) if the data is ephemeral for gpu-cache, we can delete PVCs and let ArgoCD recreate them. We should classify apps by data criticality and pick per-app strategy.

arjun: did the Prune=false patch work? I applied it at 14:32 and retriggered sync.

deploy-bot: argocd: sync started for app-of-apps-eu at 14:33. Subsequent child apps: gpu-worker-eu-01 -> Synced, gpu-worker-eu-02 -> Synced, gpu-training-eu -> Synced (no prune).

arjun: good, cluster health returned to green for most services. GPU capacity autoscaler picked up new nodes. But note: because prune was off, we now have legacy PVCs still present in some namespaces.

kevin: next steps: 1) triage which apps have non-ephemeral PVCs (marta/hana), 2) plan migration per-app, 3) add CI guard to prevent changing storageClassName for existing PVCs without a migration plan, 4) add an ArgoCD pre-sync check that fails early if templates attempt to modify immutable fields on existing resources. I'll own CI guard.

marta: I'll pull a list via: `kubectl get pvc --all-namespaces -o custom-columns=NS:.metadata.namespace,NAME:.metadata.name,SC:.spec.storageClassName` and mark which ones are critical.

hana: I'll run a test migration for gpu-cache-1 in eu-west-1 on Tuesday — will use a short-lived pod to rsync data to a new PVC, update the Deployment, then delete old PVC. I estimate 2h for verification.

arjun: also let's add a short note in runbook: if app-of-apps prune blocks due to immutable field errors, do NOT force-delete child apps. instead: 1) annotate parent app with Prune=false, 2) re-sync, 3) perform resource-specific migration, 4) re-enable prune and resync.

kevin: I'll add the CI pre-commit check and a GH action that scans diffs for `spec.storageClassName` changes on PVCs and fails with a helpful message linking to the runbook.

sre-oncall: heads up on cost impact — because we couldn't rotate PVCs, some GPU pools remained at higher capacity for a few hours. Finance noted a spike in infra spend; I'll add a short postmortem note with cost delta.

marta: OK assigned: hana -> migration (gpu-cache-1 test), kevin -> CI guard, arjun -> runbook update, marta -> inventory + critical classification. We'll re-enable prune once migrations are done.

hana: ack. I'll post progress in this thread when I start the test. :rocket:

arjun: thanks everyone. leaving prune=false patch in place for now. Will add TTL: revisit at 2026-03-11T18:00Z to re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
